adds.title: NSW conversion practices ban - passed 22 March 2024, in effect 4 April 2025
adds.summary: NSW's Conversion Practices Ban Act 2024, passed 22 March 2024 and in effect 4 April 2025, bans conversion practices directed at changing or suppressing sexual orientation or gender identity, including psychological or medical interventions, counselling, or sustained messages that gender identity can be changed or suppressed through faith or effort, punishable by up to five years' imprisonment where substantial mental or physical harm is caused and up to three years' imprisonment for taking a person outside NSW for conversion therapy, with civil complaints about conduct from 4 April 2025 investigable by Anti-Discrimination NSW through conciliation or referral to the NSW Civil and Administrative Tribunal, while general religious teaching and parental discussions about gender identity, sexual activity or religion remain permitted.
